name: Cows Gone Mad: Battle for Pasture Prime
summary:
A mysterious meteor changed life on Earth forever. Humanity vanished. Predators evolved into ruthless hunters. The wolves inherited the world.

They expected the cows to disappear next.
They were wrong.

Become one of the last defenders of Pasture Prime and fight to reclaim a world stolen by predators. Explore dangerous environments, recover valuable resources, construct and expand your Cowmand Center, and prepare for increasingly deadly battles against the wolves.

Whether you prefer uncovering the story alone, surviving with friends in online co-op, or proving your herd in competitive PvP, every victory pushes the resistance one step closer to taking back their home.

Welcome to the herd.
